_comment: Example only. Copy to <workspace>/config/qa-targets.json and edit.
Repository paths and LAN hostnames are facts about one machine, so the
real file lives in the workspace beside arcadia.json — never here.
Services are controlled through each project's own scripts/services.sh;

targets.label: Production site
targets.testProcedure: What to actually do here, in one or two sentences. Name the question this target answers that no other target does.

targets.label: Local dev server
targets.testProcedure: Local targets need no versionPath: Arcadia reads the checkout's HEAD from repoPath directly. Remote targets cannot be read that way, so they self-report through versionPath or go unverified.
